fusions.name: Illegible Mould
fusions.desc: Breathes a smear of spores 5 tiles long that deals 11 damage to everything caught in it, each hit with a 40% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Smeared Print
fusions.desc: Presses a spore print onto the target that deals 4 damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Marginal Notes
fusions.desc: Healing you receive rises 40% for 14 seconds, and you regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Cross-Reference
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
